sarah: Morning — quick async sales standup. Drop 1) what you did yesterday, 2) blockers (esp. enterprise security asks), 3) plan for today. Focus deals: Flagship Health POC, OrionBank pilot, Gridly enterprise.

tim: Flagship Health — demo went well yesterday. They asked for data residency options and an integration architecture diagram. No blocker yet, but need security nav help to confirm encryption + logging. Today: draft architecture + schedule security sync.

ben: Ping on PR #452 (secure-egress). It's got a review from infra but needs one from security before I can merge. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/452 :pray:

linda-security: looping in — I'll review PR #452 later today. For Flagship, pressing asks from their infra team: SOC2 evidence + KMS key management details. If you can send me the specific questions from the customer I'll attach the artifacts.

olivia: OrionBank — legal sent a redline for the DPA, flagged requirement for subprocessor list (they want names and cloud region locations). Blocker: need a quick inventory from vendors. Today: chasing vendors, prepping a summary.

tim: quick note — I captured the Flagship asks in this checklist so we don't miss items: ```- SOC2 report (latest)
- KMS/HSM integration doc
- Data residency region options
- Network diagram + egress controls
- Contact for security scoping call```

olivia: also asked for a short note on retention policy (they want 90/365 toggles). Can we confirm retention configuration options? @linda-security any objections to sharing the retention matrix?

linda-security: safe to share high-level retention matrix (configs only), but not full audit logs. I'll draft an approved snippet by EOD.

sarah: Gridly — AE spoke with them; they're asking about dedicated capacity (predictable SLAs). Need a ballpark pricing and capacity lead time. Ben, can you confirm whether Dedicated has 4-6 week lead time for new pools?

ben: yes, typical lead time is 4 weeks for standard configs, 6 for custom network/VPC. I'll DM pricing ranges so we don't leak internal rate cards in channel.

deploy-bot: reminder — security sync scheduled 2026-03-17 16:00 PDT (calendar invite sent).

sarah: thanks all. If anyone has blockers that require me to escalate to PS or solutions, ping me directly. Otherwise drop brief status here by 11:30 so I can compile and send to the buyer threads. :thumbsup:
